name: FormSkins Pro for Contact Form 7
author: ErickDev

sections.description:
FormSkins Pro for Contact Form 7 is a lightweight plugin designed for users who want to improve the look of their Contact Form 7 forms without complications. It offers 11 distinct visual styles that adapt to any web design.

Included styles:
* Classic Card
* Modern Float (with floating labels)
* Minimal Line
* Bold Brutal
* Soft Green
* Soft Blue
* Dark Mode
* Flat Material
* Elegant Silk
* Pill Shape
* Payment Form
sections.installation:
1. Upload the formskins-pro-for-contact-form-7 folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Form Styles’ in the sidebar menu and select your favorite style.
sections.faq:
Does it work with other form plugins?

No, it is specifically designed for Contact Form 7 CSS classes.

Does it affect performance?

No, it only loads a small CSS file on the frontend if a Contact Form 7 form is present on the page.
